# Lawn Care and Snow Removal Experts

Providing seasonal property care and maintenance services across the Greater Edmonton area, with residential snow removal services available in specific regional zones.

## Core Services
- **Lawn Care & Maintenance:** Mowing, trimming, edging, fertilizing, aeration, power raking, overseeding, patching (Residential/Commercial) — https://lawncareandsnowremovalexperts.com/services/lawn-care-and-maintenance
- **Residential Snow Removal:** Driveway/walkway clearing, ice chipping, and ice melt (Spruce Grove, Edmonton, Stony Plain) — https://lawncareandsnowremovalexperts.com/services/snow-removal-services
- **Spring & Fall Clean-Up:** Leaf/debris removal, bed/hedge blowouts, light pruning — https://lawncareandsnowremovalexperts.com/services/spring-fall-clean-up
- **Property Clean-Up & Hauling:** Yard/estate clean-ups and bulk item disposal — https://lawncareandsnowremovalexperts.com/services/property-cleanup-and-maintenance
